description: Two SessionStart jobs, both exit 0 on every path. (1) scripts/heal_install.py --hook self-heals this connector's own install manifest (a byte-identical synced copy of jobsearch's adr-014 mechanism — a maintainer-only marketplace gate keeps the two copies identical): it writes a `hook-fired` diag row before the registry is even opened, then heals the version-move case (marketplace issue #11) if that is what explains the drift; same-version drift stays loud and unwritten, on purpose. (2) scripts/migrate.py --hook moves the account registry to schema 2 (registry-v2 migration, 0.5.0): it keeps a preserved copy, folds any old file-list into `accounts`, and says what it did, or what is pending, on stderr only (stdout would be injected into the session as context). Standalone: nothing else in this plugin needs a session hook.
